(async () => { const im = new Image(); im.src = '/assets/logo-512.png'; await im.decode(); const mk = async (w, h, a, b, txt) => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const g = c.getContext('2d'); const gr = g.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h); gr.addColorStop(0, a); gr.addColorStop(1, b); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); const s = Math.min(w, h) * .7; g.drawImage(im, (w - s) / 2, (h - s) / 2 - 30, s, s); g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(w / 12) + 'px sans-serif'; g.textAlign = 'center'; g.fillText(txt, w / 2, h - 40); const bl = await new Promise(r => c.toBlob(r, 'image/png')); return new File([bl], txt + '.png', { type: 'image/png' }); }; const p = await mk(1200, 1500, '#ff6a00', '#3a0d4a', 'PORTRAIT'); await WikiEditor.test.setPhotoFiles([p]); const g1 = await mk(2400, 1350, '#1b5e8a', '#ff3d00', 'PAYSAGE'); const g2 = await mk(800, 800, '#2a7a3a', '#111', 'CARRÉ'); await WikiEditor.test.addGalleryFiles([g1, g2]); const st = WikiEditor.test.state(); return JSON.stringify({ photo: st.data.photo, gal: st.data.galerie.map(g => g[0]) }); })()
